nodes.label: backend CI workflow
nodes.rationale: Runs on push to main and on every PR, path-filtered to backend/** and the workflow file itself so a workflow that doesn't check itself wouldn't break silently.

nodes.label: pgvector/pgvector:pg16 CI service
nodes.rationale: Uses the same image as Compose because pgvector is not optional — the schema declares a vector column and migrations fail against plain Postgres.

nodes.label: two-pass pytest (unit before integration)
nodes.rationale: Unit tests run before any PKA_ env var exists, deliberately: previously a leftover PKA_REPOSITORY_BACKEND made a test pass by accident because the environment satisfied a rule the test believed it was proving.
